title: Proposal for Transfer of Investments Bought Using CPF Special Account or Ordinary Account to Nominee Rather than Estate of Deceased CPF Member
what_it_is: Proposal for Transfer of Investments Bought Using CPF Special Account or Ordinary Account to Nominee Rather than Estate of Deceased CPF Member

sections.label: CPFIS investments and CPF nomination
sections.summary: CPFIS investments go to the deceased member's estate, while CPF monies under nomination are disbursed quickly, and members are told nomination does not cover CPFIS investments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The Central Provident Fund Investment Scheme, or CPFIS, investments are disbursed to the deceased member's estate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Doing so allows the beneficiaries of the estate to decide how best to manage these assets, including the preferred timing for the sale of assets, such as unit trusts and stocks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: CPF monies, on the other hand, under the CPF nomination scheme, can then be disbursed quickly without having to wait for the beneficiaries' decision on the CPFIS investments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Members are informed upfront, when making their CPF nomination, that the nomination does not cover CPFIS investments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Hence, CPF members who want their CPFIS investments to go to the same beneficiaries as their CPF nominees, should do so through their will.

sections.label: Singtel discounted shares impact
sections.summary: The main impact is on Singtel discounted shares, which are treated as suggested, and the idea could potentially be contemplated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I think it is something that we could potentially contemplate.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But to the Member's first point about members who belong to low-income families, from our understanding, based on the statistics that we have been able to aggregate thus far, the main impact is actually on the Singtel discounted shares.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Today, the Singtel discounted shares are treated as per what you have suggested.

sections.label: Estate manages CPFIS investments
sections.summary: CPFIS investments are left to the estate to manage, and other potential improvements to the scheme will be considered.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: No, sorry, we left it to the estate to manage.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But to the Member's point about some of the other potential improvements to the scheme, I am prepared to take them on board and consider.
